cancel.a: Yes. Cancel from Settings › Plan & billing and you keep your plan until the end of the period you paid for. Then your store moves to Free.

downgrade.q: What happens to my store if I go back to Free?
downgrade.a: Nothing is taken down. Every storefront, product and teammate stays. You just can't add more than Free allows until you remove some or upgrade again.

vat.a: No, prices are shown without VAT, which is added at checkout where it applies. Add your VAT ID at checkout and it appears on every invoice.

fee.q: What is the per-sale fee charged on?
fee.a: On everything the buyer pays for each sale made through Square Share checkout, delivery included. Stripe's own card processing fees are separate.

switch.a: Any time, up or down. Stripe shows exactly what you'll pay before you confirm.
